newsitem.title: FINLAND: OLVI SEES SCOPE FOR BETTER PROFITABILITY.
newsitem.headline: OLVI SEES SCOPE FOR BETTER PROFITABILITY.

text.p: Finnish brewer Olvi Oy said on Thursday it saw scope for improving profitability this year.
A number of new products, "will make an improvement in profitability possible," Olvi said in a statement with its 1996 results.

Sales were focussing "increasingly on beers and other mild alcoholic beverages," Olvi said, adding investments in exports to nearby regions had brought "promising results for early 1997 in terms of profitability."

In 1996, Olvi's operating profit fell 39 percent to 21.6 million markka. Olvi said the fall had been due to increased price competition and because sales early last year had focussed on less profitable drinks.
Olvi said it had maintained its overall market share in Finland at 11.5 percent. The group's comparable 1996 net sales at 296 million markka were largely unchanged on 1995, it said.
